plain_summary_en: This paper studies Examining the Influence of Media Coverage on Information-Seeking of Judicial Candidates. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Media coverage, News media, Public opinion, Content analysis. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
